CustomField.description: Appraised collateral value from a bank-ordered appraisal, not the borrower-stated figure. LTV is measured against this, which is why the two can disagree: the 2026 Harborview application states $6,000,000 and the appraisal came in at $5,650,000.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Appraised collateral value. Use the bank-ordered appraisal, not the borrower-stated figure.
